settings.scale: distance to min(4,n)-th nearest support location, at least 1 metre
settings.regression_bounds: clip each depth to revealed min/max at that depth
settings.simplex_outside_hull: nearest convex-hull edge projection with linear interpolation
settings.collinear_simplex: principal-axis piecewise linear interpolation, endpoint hold
settings.coincident_support: average full profiles at exactly identical xy
settings.tuning: none; recorded before running frozen validation
settings.probability: point predictions only; common external calibration
